title: Dynamics on fences
summary: Homeomorphisms of the Cantor set play a central role in topology, dynamical systems and descriptive set theory. In parallel, several classes of fence-like spaces - such as the hairy Cantor set, hairy arcs, Cantor bouquets in complex dynamics, the Lelek fan in topology and Fraïssé fence in descriptive set theory - have recently been studied for their rich structural and dynamical properties. In this paper, we introduce a general construction that associates to each homeomorphism of the Cantor set a canonically defined homeomorphism of a corresponding fence space.
